proposed_claims.allowed_wording: An explicit CM is interpreted relative to declared ordered row and column axes; for binary axes R and C it has 2^|R| rows and 2^|C| columns, and changing the split or order can change shape and cell positions without changing the Boolean function.
proposed_claims.plain_wording: The row and column choices determine the matrix's shape and addresses, not the function's answers.
proposed_claims.technical_wording: The ordered R and C lists are accumulated MSB-first into row and column indices; materialization reshapes the dense output to (1 << len(R), 1 << len(C)).
